headerDisplay: Controls a Cosori Smart Gooseneck Kettle over Bluetooth LE. Find the MAC with `cosori-probe scan` and get the registration key with `cosori-probe key-from-log` — see the [README](https://github.com/mdjhnson/homebridge-cosori-kettle-ble#readme). The kettle accepts only one Bluetooth connection: while the plugin is connected, the VeSync app cannot connect.
footerDisplay: Run this plugin as a child bridge. Docker: mount the host D-Bus with `- /run/dbus:/run/dbus-host:ro`.

registrationKey.title: Registration key
registrationKey.description: The key the kettle accepts. Reuse the VeSync app's key (`cosori-probe key-from-log`) or pair a new one (`cosori-probe pair`). Treat it like a password.

oneOf.title: On demand — connect for commands and a slow poll, then disconnect (lets the VeSync app connect in between)

pollInterval.title: Poll interval while connected (seconds)
pollInterval.description: The kettle also pushes changes on its own; polling refreshes on-base and keep-warm state.

idleDisconnect.title: On demand: disconnect after idle (seconds)
idleDisconnect.description: The plugin stays connected while the kettle is heating or keeping warm.

delayStartSwitch.title: Delay Start switch (uses the kettle's own timer)
delayStartSwitch.description: Uses the kettle's own timer, so it still fires if Homebridge or Bluetooth is down at that moment. For an exact time of day, a Home app automation or Siri ("at 6:45 turn on Green Tea") is more flexible.

switches.title: Temperature switches
switches.description: Each item is a switch in the Home app that heats the kettle to its temperature. Leave the list empty to get the kettle's four presets.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: °F (104–212) or °C (40–100). Values from 101 to 103 are neither and are skipped.

dbusAddress.title: D-Bus address
dbusAddress.description: "auto" uses /run/dbus-host/system_bus_socket when mounted (Docker), otherwise the system bus. Or give a socket path / unix:path=… address.

adapter.title: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.description: Leave empty to use the first adapter. With a USB Bluetooth adapter, enter its MAC address (from `cosori-probe adapters` or `bluetoothctl list` on the host): names like hci1 can change after a reboot, the MAC can't.

items.helpvalue:
Kettle presets: Green Tea 180 °F / 82 °C · Oolong 195 °F / 91 °C · Coffee 205 °F / 96 °C · Boil 212 °F / 100 °C. Any other temperature from 104–212 °F (40–100 °C) also works; the kettle stores it as its MyBrew temperature.

With the list empty, a new install gets the four presets and an older install keeps the preset tiles it has. Renaming a switch here (beyond capitals) creates a new tile in the Home app. To keep its room and automations, rename it in the Home app instead.
